items: SOKOTO STATE (PSI 9.2): Governor Aliyu Rolls Out 100 APCs, Thermal Scopes and Hardware to Combat Insecurity
TARABA STATE (PSI 9.1): Governor Kefas Unveils N2.5bn Relief Package, 168-Ward Project and Public Debt Audit
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 9.0): Governor Mutfwang Pursues EU Hydro and Agric Deals; Greater Jos Master Plan Engages Stakeholders
BORNO STATE (PSI 8.9): Governor Zulum Highlights 1,500 Cluster Projects and Resettlement of 2 Million Residents
ONDO STATE (PSI 8.8): Governor Aiyedatiwa Recruits 3,323 Health Workers and Secures 26,000 Ha for Agriculture
OSUN STATE (PSI 8.6): Osun Ranks 5th Nationally in NECO SSCE as Governor Adeleke Expands Health and Road Works
EBONYI STATE (PSI 8.5): General Hospital Izhiangbo Expands TURP Capacity; Offers Free Prostate Surgeries
LAGOS STATE (PSI 8.4): Lagos Advances Epe Waste-to-Energy Project and Flood Infrastructure Interventions
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.3): Governor Fintiri Grants Executive Clemency to Inmates; State Supports 200 Hospital Patients
GOMBE STATE (PSI 8.2): Gombe Launches Tetanus Elimination Campaign across 5 LGAs; Participates in HSE Workshop
SOKOTO (PSI 9.2): Deployed 100 Buffalo APCs, 100 thermal scopes, 200 night-vision goggles, 3,200 hardware units, and 700 Guard Corps motorcycles to combat regional banditry.
TARABA (PSI 9.1): Unveiled N2.5bn relief package (N500m TARABA CARES, N1bn youth, N1bn crisis recovery), launched 168-ward project, ordered debt disclosures, and pardoned 24 inmates.
PLATEAU (PSI 9.0): Hosted EU Ambassador to advance 5MW Assop Falls hydro and agric exports, integrated waste-to-fertilizer into Greater Jos Master Plan, and pardoned 130 inmates.
BORNO (PSI 8.9): Reported executing 1,500 cluster projects across 27 LGAs, rebuilding 30,000 public structures, resettling 2m IDPs, and expanding secondary schools to 129.
ONDO (PSI 8.8): Confirmed recruitment of 3,323 health workers, acquisition of 26,000 hectares for farming, 2m cocoa seedlings distribution, and progress on 30MW Ore IPP.
OSUN (PSI 8.6): Celebrated Osun ranking 5th nationally in 2026 NECO SSCE, reviewed primary healthcare coverage expansion, and presented prizes at state essay competition.
EBONYI (PSI 8.5): Expanded Transurethral Resection of the Prostate capacity at General Hospital Izhiangbo, announcing free telescopic screening and surgeries from October 5.
LAGOS (PSI 8.4): Detailed Epe waste-to-energy investments, modern transfer loading stations, and drainage clearing operations that reduced statewide flooding by 75-80%.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.3): Granted clemency to 9 inmates and commuted 1 death sentence, while state delegation visited ADSU/MAUTH teaching hospitals supporting 200 patients and newborns.
GOMBE (PSI 8.2): Flagged off Maternal and Neonatal Tetanus Elimination vaccination across 5 LGAs and participated in a 5-day community HSE workshop with NCDMB.
